title: Lebanon Faces Economic ‘Catastrophe’ After War and Years of Mismanagement
summary: Hezbollah’s conflict with Israel and the U.S.-Israel war with Iran have made systemic problems worse, causing the cost of living to soar and driving many Lebanese to despair.
